vibe: Precision over brute force: run the narrowest test that proves your change, never the whole suite.
highlights: Validation is mapped to change type via a table, enforcing the narrowest possible test scope.
Bare `pnpm test` and `pnpm doctest` are explicitly forbidden because they start watch mode.
Generated files (barrel `index.ts`, `LLMS.md`, migration docs) must be regenerated, never hand-edited.
Type-system behavior is validated with tstyche (`pnpm test-types`), not runtime tests.
Ad hoc probes go in `scratchpad/<name>.ts` and must be removed when finished.
assessment: This file reflects a mature monorepo discipline where correctness is proven by the smallest possible command, not by running everything. The explicit mapping from change type to validation command prevents both under-testing and wasteful full-suite runs, while the generated-file rules protect a large codebase from drift. The tone is terse and operational, treating the reader as a competent contributor who needs guardrails, not tutorials.
